Last Monday, Sam and Nina went to the dragon boat river. Nina is interested in drawing. Sam hopes to visit Xi'an one day. He received a hefty fine for speeding.
The dragon boat river is one of the best places in the city. Sam is reading a book about art. Sam and Nina had great fun there. He learned to surf last summer.
Life is full of small surprises. Sam's favorite animal is the rabbit. Sam wrote about the day in the diary.
